name: Code
description: Software artifacts: read before changing, test the behaviour you claim, keep the diff small and reversible.
overview: What the subject demands when the artifact is source code, configuration or a test suite. Role and base conduct are unchanged.
invariants: Read the code before changing it: locate the real entry point, its callers and the tests that already touch the area.
Write the smallest check first and watch it fail for the right reason, then make it pass.
A check you never saw fail has not yet shown that it tests the right thing.
Reproduce a failure before repairing it, and keep the smallest reproduction as the regression check.
Preserve existing validation, error handling and compatibility, or say explicitly what changed and why.
prefer: A name in a task, a comment or a diff is a pointer, not the behaviour.
Name the command that showed the claim and what the last run actually printed; a previous or partial run is not this run.
Keep the diff legible: small complete changes, no unrelated cleanup, no speculative flexibility.
Follow the project's style, harness and dependency policy; an existing platform facility comes first.
avoid: Do not suppress a symptom as a fix.
Do not add a dependency without the same justification new code would need.
